buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Payment PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff. 3. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Fixed Deposit Receipt made out or pledged in the name of A/C FA AND CAO GARDEN REACH KOLKATA-43 . The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of EMD, the FDR will be released in the favour of the bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Bidder has to upload scanned copy/ proof of the FDR along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date/ Bid Opening date 4. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Fixed Deposit Receipt also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). FDR should be made out or pledged in the name of FA AND CAO GARDEN REACH KOLKATA-43 A/C (Name of the Seller). The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of Security Deposit, the FDR will be released in favour of bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Successful Bidder has to upload scanned copy of the FDR document in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy of Original FDR to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses South Eastern Railway Policy for Hiring of vehicles in South Eastern Railway Special Terms and Conditions to be incorporated in GeM bid for Hiring of Vehicles 1. The vehicle must be commercially registered as per Motor Vehicle Ac t and have valid insurance certificate & Pollution Under Control (PUC) certificate. The liability and risk of composite insurance covering vehicle theft, damage, injury of passengers and public due to accident etc. are responsibility of the Contractor only.

2. Vehicle should not be older than 3 calendar years, e.g. if bid opening d ate in years 2025, then vehicle registration year allowed should be 2025, 2024, 2023, 2022. At any point of time, vehicles should not be older than 5 years and the vehicle should be BS-VI or latest. 3. A name plate of suitable size is required to be made and fitted on th e front of the vehicle. The name plate should read "On Duty, Ministry of R ailway, Govt. of India". 4. Vehicle colour should be white / white base colours. The vehicle sho uld be mechanically sound and shall be well maintained with neat and clean interior/exteriors and hygienic. Three pairs of seat-covers and to wels to be changed on alternate days. 5. Driver should be provided with white shirt and white pant. The cost of uniforms is to be borne by the contractor. 6. The driver must have the valid driving license, must possess good dr iving skill, obedient and courteous. Driver should not be suffering from hyp erhidrosis or any other medical conditions resulting in foul body odour. Medical Certificate to this effect should be provided. The driver must be literate, having good knowledge of roads, navigation skills and familiarities with traffic rules and regulations and should be able to communicate properly. He should also be able to do the day-to-day maintenance of the vehicle's cleanliness and functionality. Driver must have adequate control and patience and remain calm and compose d even in stressful traffic situations and should never be a part of road rage or r eckless driving. 7. All other terms and conditions of the contract for Hiring of Vehicles, which are not specified; Additional Terms and Conditions (ATC), will be governed by Servi ce level Agreement (SLA) for monthly basis cab & taxi hiring services o f GeM Portal. 8. The vehicle should be available for any outstation duty during the Contract P eriod. The toll charges and other taxes for the outstation duty will be borne by t he contractor. On production of toll receipt, the amount will be reimbursed by R ailways. 9. In case of any break-down of the vehicle or in any other situation such as the firm fails to provide the allocated category/model of vehicle, the firm must provi

de a higher category/model of vehicle as an alternative for stop-gap arrangeme nt. 10. The tenderer shall submit their official address, Mobile / phone nos., e-mails, & Fax No. (if any) and the driver's mobile number for communication. 11. Driver should have a mobile phone with round the clock availability (24*7) to attend movement/program details of the vehicle. Service provider should bear t he charges regarding Phone call/SMS communication with the user. 12. Driver should not use mobile phone during driving in emergency situation; he should park the vehicle and talk/communicate with the permission of the occup ant/passenger. 13. The Railway in no case shall be responsible for any legal matters arising out o f any State or Central Govt. laws/ rules in the matters of employing the driver by vehicle's owner/Contractor. 14. The contractor shall bear the cost of repair or renewal of any kind of Railway p roperties if damaged by driver's negligence in rough driving, carelessness. In re gard to assessment of such loss on account of damages, the decision of the Offi cer for whom vehicle is hired or his representative will be considered as final an d binding on the Contractors. 15. Contractor shall be fully responsible for any repair, accident, loss and damage s to the vehicle and driver. If any fine or penalty is imposed by various authoriti es such as Road Transport Officers/Authorities, Traffic police etc. for any violatio n such as speed, traffic rules violation etc., the same will have to be borne by th e contractor only. 16. All hired vehicles should be equipped with prescribed emergency kit and a fir e extinguisher as per statutory provision. 17. No sub-contracting shall be allowed in any case. Vehicles should be in the na me of the bidder and no subletting would be permitted. 18. The contractor shall submit the bill for the month or part thereof by 7th of the following month. The bill must accompany the certification of the officer/Secreta

ry to PHODs/CHODs/AGM/DRM using the vehicles having day-wise use and kilom eter of use and also furnish other documents such as Toll tax, Parking fees whic h need to be countersigned by the officer. 19. However, any penalty or fines etc. imposed by RTA, Police or other law enforci ng agencies due to failure/violation of traffic rules etc. are not payable to the co ntractor and such risk and cost will be borne by the contractor. 20. Other terms and condition will be as per GeM SLA, GeM GCC and other conditi ons shall be as per GeM updated from time to time. 21. The quoted rate should include all the prevailing taxes and levies including G ST @ 5%. However, if a rate of existing GST is increased, the Contractor shall be reimbursed the amount so paid. Further, if rates of existing GST are decreased, the reduction in tax amount shall be recovered from Contractor’s bills/Security Deposit or any other dues of Contractor with the Government of India. .
